text:
cassie: quick UX review 14 users miss Export in Trace Inspector. proposal: surface a small export affordance near correlation id instead of hiding in kebab.
rafa: agreed. during incidents we need one-click export. kebab is too buried.
mina: compromise: compact export icon next to id + full 'Export trace' button in header for bulk exports. keeps copy primary.
oliver: accessibility: icon needs aria-label (e.g. "Export trace") and keyboard focus. modal must trap focus and close on Escape.
cassie: mock idea: [export icon] [copy id] <id> 12 icon opens quick menu (JSON/CSV), header has full Export trace.
rafa: tooltip text tweak: change "Copied!" -> "Trace ID copied" so it's explicit.
mina: filename pattern request from ops: include date + short id. suggestion: redwood-trace-20260323-1a2b3c4d.json (shortid = first 8 chars). filename should be editable in dialog and have helper text: "We include timestamp for you 6 edit if needed."
oliver: dev notes: add aria-live region announcing "Trace ID copied" and debounce announcements. ensure visible focus ring and keyboard-only styles.
cassie: a11y checklist: focus moves into dialog on open, returns on close, role=dialog, aria-modal, Esc closes. tab order: format radios -> include spans checkbox -> filename input -> Export (primary) -> Cancel.
mina: i'll own copy + dialog copy updates.
rafa: i'll update Figma with header export and icon placement.
oliver: i'll add aria labels and focus behavior in prototype and update CSS tokens.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging 2026-03-23T18:00Z for branch trace-inspector-export-nits.
cassie: i'll add a note in staging release notes about filename change. reconvene after staging smoke tests. :thumbsup:
